Title 4: 01 - P2P - Purchase Contract & Quantity Cost Breaks
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a vendor purchase contract with quantity cost breaks, including importing contracts and cost breaks by CSV. Test: (1) Enter a purchase contract (Transactions > Purchases > Enter Purchase Contracts) for an approved vendor and item with start/end dates, payment terms, incoterms and a quantity discount break. (2) Import a second contract and its cost breaks with the Test Import Single PC.csv template (Internal IDs for subsidiary, item, units). (3) Import a file with a bad Internal ID and a missing mandatory field. Expected: price tiers show on the contract; only the bad row fails, with a readable error. Data: approved vendor and 1-2 items. The contract is used to price the PO in 03. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Purchase Contract (130283); 06 - Import/Update Quantity Cost Breaks for Purchase Contracts (135763)

Title 4: 02 - P2P - Create Deviated Cost Record
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a deviated cost record for special purchase pricing tied to an end customer, and that purchase orders pick it up. Test: (1) Create a deviated cost record for a SKU, vendor and end customer with a special cost and effective dates. (2) Create a PO for that end customer's order. (3) Create a PO for the same SKU for a different customer, and one dated outside the effective dates. (4) Bill the first PO at the deviated price. Expected: only the first PO uses the deviated cost, the others use the standard price, and the bill has no price variance. [SME to confirm record type and fields] Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 04 - Customer-Specific Group Price Levels (130228); 05 - Vendor Pricing (130231)

Title 4: 03 - P2P - Purchase Order Creation
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a purchase order to a vendor against the purchase contract, including pricing, terms and incoterms. Test: (1) Enter a PO (Transactions > Purchases > Enter Purchase Order) with vendor, subsidiary, location, currency, items, quantity, expected ship date and tax code. (2) Confirm the rate defaults from the contract in 01 and terms default from the vendor. (3) Enter lines above and below a contract quantity break. (4) Check the standard FOB/incoterm fields. Expected: each line gets the correct price tier. Data: create two POs, one in a low and one in a higher approval band, for 04. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02 - Create Purchase Order to Vendor (130285)

Title 4: 04 - P2P - Purchase Order Approval
Description: [Monday] Validate purchase order approval routing by order total, rejection and resubmission, re-approval on change, and that users cannot approve their own orders. Test: (1) Save both POs and confirm Approval Status = Pending Approval and the approving role (Inventory L1/L2/L3) follows the PO total. (2) Try to email or issue a PO while pending. (3) Reject one PO as the approver, then resubmit and approve it. (4) Try to approve a PO as its creator. (5) Edit an approved PO so the total crosses the next threshold. Expected: pending PO cannot be issued; creator cannot self-approve (routes to an alternate); Resubmit appears and approval restarts at the higher level; originator gets an email on approve/reject. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 04 - Purchase Order Approval (130287)

Title 4: 05 - P2P - Print & Email Purchase Order PDF
Description: [Monday] Validate printing the purchase order PDF and emailing it to the vendor. Test: (1) On the approved PO click Print PO PDF and check vendor, ship-to, terms, incoterm, currency and lines. (2) Email the PDF from the Communication subtab, including more than one recipient if configured. Expected: PDF is correct and the email is logged under Communication > Messages. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 05 - Print Purchase Order PDF (131557)

Title 4: 06 - Warehouse - Receive Purchase Order (Item Receipt)
Description: [Monday] Validate receiving the purchase order into the warehouse with lot and expiry details, including partial receipts and an over-receipt attempt. Test: (1) Receive part of the PO (Receive button or WMS) entering lot number, bin, status, expiry date and quantity. (2) Confirm PO status = Partially Received. (3) Try to receive more than the ordered quantity, and a lot with a past expiry date; record whether the system blocks or warns. (4) Receive the remainder. Expected: PO moves to Pending Bill and both receipts show under Receipts & Bills. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Receive Purchase Order (130334)

Title 4: 07 - Warehouse - Bin Putaway & Inbound Labels
Description: [Monday] Validate putting received inventory away to bins and printing inbound labels. Test: (1) Transactions > Inventory > Bin Putaway Worksheet: select subsidiary and location, assign bin quantity and lot detail, save. (2) In WMS Receiving, print an inbound label from the Enter Quantity screen. Expected: stock moves to the assigned bin; on-hand by bin and lot is correct; the label shows item, lot and expiry. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 04 - Bin Putaway (130331); Print Inbound Labels (137807)

Title 4: 08 - R2R - Vendor Bill from Purchase Order
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a vendor bill from a received purchase order. Test: (1) On the received PO click Bill. (2) Confirm vendor, subsidiary, items and amounts carry over; enter the vendor invoice number as Reference No. (3) Check due date (from terms), tax code and AP account, then save. Expected: a bill at the exact PO price and received quantity needs no approval, and the PO bill status updates. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Vendor Bill from Purchase Order (131497)

Title 4: 09 - R2R - Vendor Bill from Item Receipt
Description: [Monday] Validate identifying goods received not billed and creating a vendor bill from an item receipt. Test: (1) Run the saved search Goods Received not Billed and find the test PO lines (partial and full receipts). (2) Open the Item Receipt and click Bill. (3) Review and save. Expected: details carry over from the receipt and the line drops off the saved search once billed. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Vendor Bill from Item Receipt (131496)

Title 4: 10 - R2R - Three-Way Match Variances
Description: [Monday] Validate three-way match, including bill quantity above received and bill price different to the purchase order, and variance approval. Test: (1) On a PO with a partial receipt, create a bill with a quantity above the received quantity. (2) Create another bill with a price above the PO price, and one below. Expected: each variance sends a notification to the next approver to approve or reject; a rejected bill goes back for correction; a bill within tolerance needs no approval. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 07 - 3-Way Match (130127)

Title 4: 11 - R2R - Standalone Vendor Bill
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a standalone vendor bill not tied to a purchase order, including payment hold. Test: (1) Transactions > Payables > Enter Bills with a vendor and the charge item Test Fee, no PO. (2) Check subsidiary, memo, due date, department, location and tax code. (3) Tick Payment Hold on a second bill. Expected: both save correctly; the held bill cannot be selected for payment in 13. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Standalone Vendor Bill (130129)

Title 4: 12 - R2R - Vendor Credits
Description: [Monday] Validate creating vendor credits (from a bill, from a VRMA, and standalone) and applying them to open bills. Test: (1) Create a vendor credit from an existing bill. (2) Create a vendor credit from a VRMA. (3) Create a standalone vendor credit. (4) Apply credits to open bills, including a credit smaller than the bill. Expected: bill balances, AP and the vendor credit balance update correctly. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 04 - Create a Vendor Credit from a Vendor Bill (131499); 04 - Create a Vendor Credit from a VRMA (131500); 04 - Create a Standalone Vendor Credit (not from a Vendor Bill or VRMA) (131501); 04 - Apply Vendor Credits to Bills (131498)

Title 4: 13 - R2R - Vendor Payments
Description: [Monday] Validate creating and applying vendor payments against open vendor bills, including partial payments. Test: (1) On an approved bill click Make Payment and pay in full. (2) On another bill pay a partial amount. (3) Try to pay the bill on Payment Hold. Expected: full payment closes the bill; partial payment leaves the correct open balance; the held bill is blocked. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02 - Create Vendor Payments (130130)

Title 4: 14 - R2R - Vendor Prepayment & Refund
Description: [Monday] Validate creating a vendor prepayment and recording a vendor refund. Test: (1) Create a vendor prepayment and apply it to a later bill. (2) Record a vendor refund that is not from a VRMA. Expected: GL and vendor balances are correct and the prepayment is applied against the bill. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 03 - Create Vendor Prepayments (130131); 05 - Record Vendor Refund (not from VRMA) (131502)

Description: [Monday] Validate vendor bank payment details and generating the Franx EFT payment file for vendor payments, including remittance emails. Test: (1) On the vendor, Bank Payment Details > New Bank Details with format Franx Netherlands (bank name, creditor name, IBAN, subsidiary) and tick EFT Bill Payment. (2) Try an invalid IBAN. (3) On the bill payment tick For Electronic Bank Payment and choose the Preferred Entity Bank. (4) Payments > Bank File Generation > Generate Bill Payment File (Franx B.V. account, saved search Bill Payment Transactions). (5) Check bulk remittance email. Expected: file contains only eligible EFT payments with correct totals. Record the payments for the bank file in 41. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 06 - Send payments via bank integration (130133); Franx (130829); 03 - Vendor Bank/Payment Details (130299); 08- Bulk Email EFT Payment Remittance (135987)

Title 4: 16 - P2P - Intercompany Purchase Order, Sales Order, Fulfillment & Receipt
Description: [Monday] Validate the intercompany loop: intercompany purchase order, generated intercompany sales order, fulfillment by the selling subsidiary, and receipt by the purchasing subsidiary. Test: (1) Create an intercompany PO using the intercompany vendor. (2) Transactions > Sales > Manage Intercompany Sales Orders: generate the SO from the IC PO. (3) Fulfil the SO from the selling subsidiary (pack and ship). (4) Receive the PO in the purchasing subsidiary with the same lot. Expected: paired documents link, the lot matches, and intercompany balances are correct. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 03 - Create Intercompany Purchase Order (130282); 03 - Create Intercompany Sales Order (130188); 12 - Fulfill Intercompany Sales Order (130312); 02 - Receive Intercompany Purchase Order (130332)

Title 4: 17 - O2C - Create Customer Billing Account
Description: [Tuesday] Validate creating a customer billing account and that it defaults onto sales orders and shipments. Test: (1) On the test customer create the customer-specific shipping method / billing account (carrier, account number). (2) Create an SO and confirm shipping method and billing account default. (3) Leave a required field blank or enter an invalid format. (4) Change the account after the SO exists. Expected: invalid entry is blocked; an existing SO is unchanged. The account is used at pack and ship in 23. [SME to confirm fields] Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): Create Customer Specific Shipping Method (136367); Apply Shipping Method/3PB (137639); 01 - Create Customer (130179)

Title 4: 18 - O2C - Quote Creation, Approval & PDF
Description: [Tuesday] Validate quote creation with customer pricing, approval routing, and sending the quote PDF to the customer. Test: (1) Transactions > Sales > Prepare Quotes for an approved customer with 2 lines, one at the customer-specific price and one at base price, with Customer Part Number, Customer Ref #, incoterm and expiry. (2) Try to create an SO while the quote is Pending Approval. (3) Reject, resubmit and approve. (4) Edit the approved quote. (5) Print Quote PDF and email it. Expected: customer price is applied; SO blocked until approved; creator cannot approve their own quote; modifying an approved quote forces re-approval. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Quote (130195); 02 - Approve Quotes (130432); 03 - Send Quote PDF (130435); 03 - Customer Pricing (130227)

Title 4: 19 - O2C - Sales Order from Quote, Approval & Acknowledgement
Description: [Tuesday] Validate creating a sales order from the approved quote, order approval routing, and sending the order acknowledgement. Test: (1) From the approved quote click Sales Order; confirm prices, CPNs, terms and incoterm carry over and the quote becomes Processed. (2) Create a standalone SO in a higher approval band. (3) Check the approving role follows the order total and the pending SO cannot be fulfilled. (4) Edit the approved SO so the total crosses the next threshold. (5) Confirm the shipping charge is taxed and the VAT code fits the ship-to country. (6) Email the order acknowledgement PDF. Expected: re-approval is triggered; acknowledgement uses the updated KE SO layout. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Sales Order from Quote (130190); 02a - Create Standalone Sales Order (130189); 04 - Sales Order Approval (130192); 05 - Send Order Acknowledgement PDF (130193)

Title 4: 20 - O2C - Credit Hold & Release
Description: [Tuesday] Validate customer credit hold behavior on sales orders and releasing held orders or lines with an authorized role. Test: (1) Set the customer Hold to Auto with a credit limit below open balance plus the new order and create an SO. (2) Set Hold to On for another customer. (3) Check the held lines on the wave page. (4) Try to override as Customer Service, then as an authorized role (Accounting Manager / Operations Manager) for one line and for the whole order. (5) Run the saved searches Orders on Credit Hold (Credit Limit and Past Due). Expected: held lines are not released; only authorized roles can override. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 04 - Manage Credit Holds (130182)

Title 4: 21 - P2P - Link PO to SO (Lot Assignment)
Description: [Tuesday] Validate linking a purchase order to a sales order so inbound lots are assigned to the right customer order. Test: (1) Create an SO for an item with insufficient stock and a PO for the same item. (2) Link the PO line to the SO line. (3) Receive the PO partially and run lot assignment (runs every 2 hours). (4) Try to link a different item or a closed SO. Expected: the received lot is assigned to the linked SO and not taken by other orders; invalid links are blocked. [SME to confirm the linking mechanism; the RTM lists linking POs to orders as a Confirmed Gap] Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): Link Purchase Orders to Sales Orders for Lot Assignment (138257)

Title 4: 22 - Warehouse - Wave Creation, Release & Pick
Description: [Tuesday] Validate creating and releasing a wave for the approved sales order and picking it in WMS, including a short pick and shelf-life lot rules. Test: (1) Try to put an unapproved SO and a credit-held SO on a wave. (2) Transactions > Order Management > Create a Wave for the approved SO and release it. (3) In WMS Single Order Picking (Released Orders) pick less than the line quantity. (4) Pick a lot that violates the customer shelf-life/spec requirement. Expected: held orders do not release; the wave links under Related Records on the SO; the short pick leaves a backorder; the bad lot is blocked or warned. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02 - Create Wave (130303); 04 - Pick Order (130305); 01 - Manage Allocations for Shelf Life Required and Specs (131212)

Title 4: 23 - Fulfillment - Pack & Ship via ShipHawk (Training Call)
Description: [Tuesday] Validate packing and shipping the picked order, including packing slip and commercial invoice. ShipHawk-supported ship methods to be covered on the ShipHawk training call (tentative); other ship methods in NetSuite. Test: (1) On the ShipHawk training call pack and ship a ShipHawk-supported method and confirm the tracking number, label and cost return to the Item Fulfillment [tentative]. (2) For a method not supported by ShipHawk pack in Ship Central with pallet weight and dimensions, then Mark Shipped in NetSuite. (3) Apply the shipping method and billing account from 17. (4) Print the packing slip, commercial invoice/pro forma and BOL. Expected: documents are correct; the SO shows Partially Fulfilled with the remaining quantity open. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 07 - Pack Order From NetSuite (130309); 09 - Ship Order From NetSuite (137638); 09 - Ship Order From ShipHawk (130310); Apply Shipping Method/3PB (137639); 05 - Print Packing Slip PDF (130306); 08 - Print Commercial Invoice / Pro Forma Invoice PDF (130307); Calculate Shipping Costs (131224)

Title 4: 24 - R2R - Invoice from Sales Order & Email Invoice
Description: [Tuesday] Validate invoicing the shipped order (including a partial shipment), printing the sales invoice, and emailing it to the customer. Test: (1) Let automated invoicing run, or use Transactions > Sales > Invoice Sales Orders (status Pending Billing / Partially Fulfilled). (2) Check only shipped quantities are invoiced, plus VAT code, terms, currency and default comments. (3) Print the sales invoice PDF and email it with the invoice email template. Expected: the backordered quantity is not billed; the Lock AR workflow does not block the automatic invoice (UAT 1 issue). Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Create Invoices from Sales Orders (130137); 03 - Email Invoice to Customer (130139); 11 - Print Sales Invoice PDF (130311); 15 - Invoice Generation Automation (140660)

Title 4: 25 - R2R - Apply Customer Payments
Description: [Tuesday] Validate applying customer payments against the open invoice, including a partial payment and an overpayment. Test: (1) Accept Payment on the invoice for a partial amount. (2) Apply a second payment for the balance plus a small overpayment. Expected: the invoice balance is correct after each payment; overpayment is handled per policy (record the actual behavior). Record invoice numbers and amounts for the bank file in 41. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 10 - Apply Customer Payments (130135)

Title 4: 26 - O2C - Customer Credit Card Payment (Adyen)
Description: [Tuesday] Validate taking a customer credit card payment through Adyen, including declines, deposits and refunds. Test: (1) Take a card payment on an open invoice or deposit with an Adyen test card. (2) Repeat with a declined card and a 3DS card. (3) Refund the payment. (4) Check the GL accounts and how processing fees are recorded (RTM: Confirmed Gap). Expected: a decline leaves the invoice open; the refund returns to the card through Adyen. [SME to confirm the Adyen flow and trigger point] Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 16 - Customer Credit Card Payments (141981); 12 - Create Customer Deposit/Prepayment (131491); 11 - Create a Customer Refund (not from RMA) (131495)

Title 4: 27 - O2C - Updates to Product Order Fulfillment Pricing
Description: [Tuesday] Validate updating Order Fulfillment product pricing in the pricing table and item record fields, and that new orders and invoices use the updated prices. Test: (1) Update the price of an Order Fulfillment item in the pricing table. (2) Update the related Order Fulfillment fields on the item record. (3) Run a CSV price update with one valid and one invalid row (Item, Currency, Price, Price Level, Quantity). (4) Create and invoice a new Order Fulfillment order. Expected: the new order uses the new price; an order created before the change keeps its price; the invalid row is rejected with an error. [SME to list the fields] Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 01 - Set Item Pricing (130229); 02 - Update Item Pricing (130230); 03 - Customer Pricing (130227); 02 - Create 'Order Fulfillment' Outbound (130485); Invoice Order Fulfillment (141095)

Description: [Wednesday] Validate setting up the CGS slit Linqtape assembly item, its BOM and BOM revision, and the MOQ flag on the item record. Description: [Wednesday] Validate the CGS outsourced manufacturing scenario starting from the customer sales order for the slit tape SKU and the raw material and MOQ check at the CGS location. Test: (1) Create and approve an SO for the slit Linqtape SKU. (2) Review parent-log inventory at the CGS location and the MOQ on the item record. Description: [Wednesday] Validate purchasing the MOQ of CGS full logs and receiving them as Krayden-owned inventory at the CGS contract manufacturing location. Test: (1) Create a standard PO to CGS for the six full logs at actual cost; approve and issue it. (2) Receive the logs into the CGS Contract Manufacturing Location. Description: [Wednesday] Validate transferring components from the Krayden Europe warehouse to the CGS location from the purchase order, including a partial transfer. Test: (1) From a component PO click Generate Transfer Order, remove a line and transfer only part of the quantity (e.g. buy 40, transfer 30, keep 10). Description: [Wednesday] Validate receiving components direct to the CGS location, including automatic receipt upon transfer order fulfillment. Test: (1) Fulfil a TO with Automatic Receipt Upon Fulfillment ticked. (2) Fulfil another TO with it unticked. Expected: the ticked TO creates its item receipt automatically for the fulfilled quantity only; the unticked TO needs the native receiving step. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02d - Receive Components Direct to Contract Manufacturing (133800)

Title 4: 33 - MFG - CGS: Create Outsourced Purchase Order
Description: [Wednesday] Validate creating the outsourced manufacturing purchase order to CGS with the outsourcing charge item, BOM and BOM revision. Test: (1) Transactions > Purchases > Enter Purchase Orders using the form Krayden - Outsourced Purchase Order. (2) Vendor CGS; enter the assembly, outsourcing charge item, quantity, BOM and revision, production dates; leave Create WO = Yes. (3) Try an assembly with no valid BOM revision. Expected: the PO saves and creates a linked WO; invalid setup is blocked with a clear message. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02a - Create Outsourced Mfg Purchase Order (131571)

Description: [Wednesday] Validate the outsourced work order created from the purchase order, including vendor, outsourcing charge, BOM revision and dates. Test: (1) Open the WO linked from the PO and verify Outsourced is ticked, vendor, outsourcing charge, originating PO, quantity, BOM revision, location and dates. (2) Check SO > WO > PO traceability under Related Records. (3) Also test creating the WO first (Transactions > Manufacturing > Enter Work Orders), firming it and checking the Outsourcing subtab. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 02b - Create Outsourced Mfg Work Order (131569)

Description: [Wednesday] Validate receiving the outsourced purchase order and completing the assembly build, including a partial completion. (2) Complete the Assembly Build Helper lot/bin detail for components and finished good. (3) Open the Assembly Build, then receive the remaining quantity. Description: [Wednesday] Validate the automatic transfer order and fulfillment of finished goods from CGS to the Krayden Europe warehouse and the Pending TO Receipt status. Test: (1) Tick Automatic Transfer and Fulfillment Upon Receipt/Build on the item receipt before saving. (2) Confirm a TO from CGS to the Return Location is created and auto-fulfilled. (3) Check the PO and WO status. Expected: the custom Pending TO Receipt status shows while the TO is in transit. Description: [Wednesday] Validate the warehouse receipt of the finished goods transfer order from CGS. Expected: finished goods are on hand in KE and the PO/WO return to Pending Billing. Reference (existing RTM scenarios for step-by-step): 03 - Transfer Order (130337); 01 - Receive Purchase Order (130334)

Description: [Wednesday] Validate billing CGS for the outsourcing charge after the finished goods are received, including a price variance. Description: [Wednesday] Validate fulfilling, shipping and invoicing the original customer order from the CGS finished goods. Description: [Wednesday] Validate creating a planning rules group and attaching it to a supply plan definition. Description: [Thursday] Validate handling unmatched bank lines (fees, interest, unidentified receipts) with journal entries and unapplied payments.
